summary: Recent advancements in AI technology include Google DeepMind's launch of Gemini 4 Argon, a significant step forward in AI capabilities. OpenAI has enhanced its security measures by thwarting attempts to extract sensitive information from its models. Funding continues to flow into AI startups, exemplified by TrustedRouter's $1.25 million raise, while pricing variability in LLM APIs has been highlighted, with reports of costs differing by up to 33 times for the same model. Additionally, new tools like Perspica enhance project management and code review, showcasing practical applications that improve user capabilities.

items.original: Open TTS Leaderboard: Scalable Evaluation for Multilingual Text-to-Speech and Voice Cloning
items.rewritten: Hugging Face has launched the Open TTS Leaderboard, which aims to provide a scalable evaluation platform for multilingual text-to-speech and voice cloning technologies. This initiative allows developers to assess the performance of various models in a standardized manner. It is designed to foster innovation and improvement in the field of speech synthesis.

items.original: Forecasting space weather risks on power grids. Extreme space-weather events can damage power systems on Earth and degrade GPS accuracy and satellite operations. A new machine learning system can predict where damage is likely to occur 30-60 minutes before a storm arrives. The post Forecasting space weather risks on power grids appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.rewritten: Microsoft Research has developed a machine learning system that forecasts space weather risks to power grids. This system can predict potential damage from extreme space weather events 30 to 60 minutes before they occur, helping to protect power systems and improve GPS accuracy. The research emphasizes the importance of preparing for space weather impacts on technology.
